text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wah... There's such a huge variety of 
fruit-filled sweets... a-amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to try every single one, but... 
eating everything is obviously... 
impossible, right?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
HEYYY, SERVER-SA~~N!! One of EVERY DESSERT 
on the menu, PLEASE~~!! I wanna try THEM 
ALL!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Dober, let's share a ton! Even if your 
stomach gets full, just one bite of each!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll finish off ALL the leftovers! I can't 
WAAAIT for the sweets♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Somehow the two of us managed to eat it 
all. Though I ended up having to help her 
diet afterward for quite a while...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, typical of her... But weren't you 
glad to eat so many of your favorite 
things, Dober?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(It's true... Taiki really does have that 
side to her—)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Lately, I haven't been able to run 
comfortably... Haa. Should I increase my 
training volume more?)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Suzuka! Look over there, look! The 
seals are doing tricks! SO CUTE~~!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, let's go see the tropical fish area 
TOO!! Colorful little cuties fluttering 
and swaying... IT'S SO FUN!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I-I got it, I understand. Let's just look 
through them in order.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(There's a lot on my mind, but... if I 
don't put it aside right now, I feel like 
I'll lose sight of Taiki—)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —Haa, haa! ...Phew. ...Oh?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Somehow... now that my head is clear, my 
body feels lighter too...?)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oh... What is the matter, Suzuka? You 
appear to have something on your mind.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah... no. It's just... Listening to 
Dober's story, I thought how very Taiki 
that sounded—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
She can be overbearing, or rather way too 
powerful at times... but I've been saved 
by that as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right. ...Ah, come to think 
of it—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
During our party at the dorm back then, 
she went straight up to girls she'd never 
spoken to before and chatted them up—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
She'd say, "LET'S EAT SOME MEAT!", 
wouldn't she? She always goes around 
saying that during parties.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. From there they became fast friends, 
and since I was with her too... it was 
incredible.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you dragged into it too, Dober? 
It's Taiki, after all. She probably 
thought it'd be fun for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! In the end, even I ended up 
becoming close friends with those girls—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, that's amazing, Suzuka. I'm her 
roommate, so it makes sense for me, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It seems like you know everything about 
Taiki too, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Eh?! I-Is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. To see someone who was previously 
so indifferent to others speak so 
enthusiastically about a friend.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Wha—. Not you too, Air Groove...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It is nothing to be embarrassed about. 
Isn't it wonderful that you have found a 
good friend?

One day, while walking through the academy 
grounds—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: A "good friend"... huh...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah, no! Um... well—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I-It's worries about running. Things 
like... training and all that?
choice_data_list:
Worrying about running is so like you, 
Suzuka.

Worrying about running is so like you, 
Suzuka.

Is that all? It looked like something was 
bothering you more than that.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's... troubles with my running. Like, 
about training and stuff...?
choice_data_list: Worrying about running is so like you.
Worrying about running is so like you.

Is that all? Looked like you were troubled 
by more.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, that's true. ............

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: D-Did it look that obvious? ............

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No, but... not really. It's not that I'm 
in trouble.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's just... I don't really know what I 
should do, or...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I just felt a bit ticklish.
